about: The second review of 1.24.18's rules (2026-11-13), by an agent that had seen neither the rules written, the run, nor the first review: 206 cases of its own on 1.24.18 after the first review's mends and on 1.24.17, with a stand-in model and library. It found: (1) the question again kept as a NEED where the question itself says 'you' ('How many eggs do you get from a hen?'), declines that went on with the model's own knowledge in words with no digit taken for bare declines, NEEDs kept for questions about no one's things or about tomorrow; (2) names matched by their first five letters (Niger to Nigeria, Austria to Australia, India to Indiana) so that an honest 'Not in my library' became a wrong capital; (3) right chains of an unused helper line and a right word questioned, and made wrong when the model followed 'write ANS1'; (4) small words under 4.5:1 on painted colours, a striped Green-Yellow painted lime, olive and brown off. Each was mended or narrowed (CHANGELOG 1.24.18). ok_now and got_now: on the mended build, graded by its own assembler (whose notes are those of the build it tried).

known.1: misses: 'How many watts do you use each day?' (use was taken out: the question's own 'you use'), 'your household' for 'my family', a decline with advice ('Ask a local farmer')
known.2: misses: a lower-case question, 'Can you tell me ...' and '... today?' (PERSONAL), a second name the title lacks ('in English'); as on 1.24.17, the S7 Edge guide's quote questioned
known.3: as on 1.24.17, the older checks of slips question an earlier line's input typed again, anagram checks and close words; a word from nowhere is asked about only after a REVERSE of a word of the question, when nothing else uses its result
known.4: painted only when every item is a colour Lantern knows (not Munsell or RGB names, Light Blue, Spanish names, 'Red - fire')
